neighbours.label: Best guess for a broad pole: the clause or sentence boundary (',' or '.') that closes a quantitative or explanatory statement in a worked explanation, where a consequence or next step follows

notes: Card flags the pole broad (2.9% of tokens at 0.1 of max); top examples peak on ','/'.' after measurements or setup clauses and the output promotes ' accordingly', ' thus', ' thereby', ' also'. Nine probe sentences of this kind reached only 0.03-0.16 of max, so I expect this test to fail; it is registered to record that the card-level guess does not drive the pole in short passages.
